plugin.name: Web Servers
plugin.description: Manage nginx, Apache and Caddy on your hosts: sites, config, logs and HTTPS, with every change tested first.

use.title: Use Web Servers
use.description: See web servers and sites on hosts you can reach, and change them on hosts you can edit.

enable.label: Web Servers
enable.description: Manage nginx, Apache and Caddy on this host from the Web Servers tab.

useSudo.label: Use sudo
useSudo.description: Use sudo to read and change the web server. Turn off if the login is root.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Show sites, config and logs but never change them on this host.

showPanel.label: Panel beside the terminal
showPanel.description: Offer the Web Servers panel on this host's terminal tabs.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the panel with the terminal
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the Web Servers panel when a terminal opens on a host that has it.

companionSide.label: Panel side
companionSide.description: Where the panel sits next to the terminal.

companionSize.label: Panel size
companionSize.description: Width of the panel, or its height at the bottom, in pixels.

companionEdgeButton.label: Edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the terminal edge to open the panel.

tab.title: Web Servers
tab.noHost: Open Web Servers from a host.
tab.error: Could not load the web servers on this host.
tab.disabled: Web Servers is turned off for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.sudo: Changes need a root login, passwordless sudo or a saved Sudo Password on this host.
tab.noServerHint: Install nginx, Apache or Caddy from the Server page.

watch.start: Alert me when a web server stops
watch.on: You will get an alert when a web server on this host stops
watch.off: Alerts for this host are off

sites.deleteBody: The file is removed and the server reloads. A copy stays in /var/lib/termix-web-servers/backups on the host.

site.name: Site name
site.nameHint: Used for the file name and the log files, like example.
site.textHint: Saving the text turns off the form for this site, so your own changes are kept.
site.proxyHint: Sends requests to an app running on this host or another one.
site.phpHint: Serves files from a folder and runs .php files with php-fpm.
site.redirectHint: Sends every visitor to another address.
site.domainsHint: Press Enter after each one. Use _ in nginx to answer any name.
site.spaHint: Send paths that are not files to /index.html.
site.upstreamHint: Where the app listens, like http://127.0.0.1:3000.
site.keepPathHint: Send /page to the same page on the new address.
site.phpSocketHint: No php-fpm socket was found. Install php-fpm or enter host:port.
site.httpsHint: Needs a certificate. Save the site first, then press Get certificate below.
site.httpsCaddy: Caddy gets and renews the certificate by itself.

tls.title: HTTPS certificate
tls.hintManaged: certbot gets a Let's Encrypt certificate for this site's domains, then the site switches to HTTPS. certbot renews it and reloads the server.
tls.hintText: certbot gets a Let's Encrypt certificate for this site's domains. Add the certificate to the site yourself afterwards. certbot renews it and reloads the server.
tls.needCertbot: Install certbot with its plugin for this server from the Server page first.
tls.emailHint: Let's Encrypt writes here about problems. Optional.
tls.stagingHint: Use the Let's Encrypt staging server. Browsers won't trust it.

config.saveHint: The whole config is tested before the server reloads. A broken file is put back.
config.restoreBody: The file goes back to how it was at {{time}}. The current text becomes a backup too.

server.stopBody: Every site on it goes offline until you start it again.
server.installBody: It is installed with the host's package manager and starts right away. Another web server on port 80 will stop it from starting.
server.certbotHint: Gets Let's Encrypt certificates for nginx and Apache sites

card.title: Web servers
card.empty: No host has Web Servers turned on.

manager.title: Web Servers
manager.disabled: Turn on Web Servers for this host to see its sites here.
